items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: there was a little fellow who played trumpet, he come from England, his name was Roland Greenberg.

ctx.x: Prinz-- called the Swart), the Black Prince in Norway, I was the Black Prince. Cause I had taught them how to clap their hands and swing and everything else, man.

For eleven months I was a big man there. And in the meantime, while we was there, there was a little fellow who played trumpet, he come from England, his name was Roland Greenberg. Played beautiful trumpet.
And we organized a jazz -- jazz chapter in-- That's when Jazz started to catch over in Norway.
